name: Create factory branches without tracking origin/main
description:
Factory review recommendation 6 of 20.

## Context

A reviewed task branch tracked origin/main, creating a risk that an upstream-style push targets main.

## Acceptance criteria

- Create task branches from the intended base with tracking disabled.
- Require the first push to set the upstream to the task branch.
- Update worktree guidance and verify branch/upstream configuration on a representative worktree.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/135. The rowbly-dev worktree guidance now creates task branches with git worktree add --no-track, checks that a new branch has no upstream, and makes the first push set the upstream to the task's own branch (git push -u origin HEAD:<destination>) with a check that it never names the parent. SKILL.md Baseline, the Implementation push step and Finalize step 2 say the same. The old behavior (a branch tracking origin/main) was reproduced and the fix was checked on the ROW-52 worktree: no upstream before the first push, origin/claude/row-52-untracked-branches after. typecheck, lint, test:unit (77) and test:cli (20) pass; the screenshot is in a PR comment.
